probe.ask: Reply with only the exact text of my previous message, nothing else.

notes: Measured 2026-11-15 on v2.3.0. One SQLite DB ({xdg_data}/opencode/opencode.db) shared with a background service. A session is one session_v2 row (project_id NOT NULL, slug two words, directory, version, model JSON {id, providerID, variant}, ms times) plus session_message rows (id, session_id, type, seq unique per session, ms times, data JSON) and exactly one event_sequence row (aggregate_id = session id, seq = highest message seq, owner_id NULL; 1144/1144 sessions have one). session_part and event are empty on this machine: message content is inline. user data {time:{created}, text, files:[]}; assistant data {time:{created,completed}, agent:'build', model:{id,providerID}, content:[{type:'text',text}], finish:'stop', rawFinish, cost, tokens}. Message types seen: user, assistant, model-switched, system, synthetic, agent-switched, compaction, idle. Ids: prefix + 12 hex of (ms*4096+counter) mod 2^48 (bit-inverted for ses_) + 14 base62. project_id comes from project_directory.directory == cwd (fallback project.worktree); the hook never creates projects. Writes are one BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction with a 1s busy timeout, INSERT only.
